messages:
jordan_infra: Quick heads-up — planning a rolling node reboot + NIC microcode push in eu-west3 tonight. Proposed window 23:45-02:15 UTC, targeting pools eu-west3-gpu-a and -b. Reason: intermittent NIC drops we've seen in metrics. Expected transient capacity loss ~15% during each cohort.
ops-bot: Maintenance scheduled by jordan_infra. Start: 1765234567 (23:45 UTC). Components: nic-fw, kernel-livepatch, graceful-reboot. Estimated duration: 2h30m.
sam_ops: Can we move start to 01:15 UTC? telemetry shows a heavy tail at 00:45-01:30 on eu-west3 today.
jordan_infra: @sam_ops good catch. We can shift to 01:15-03:45 UTC but that pushes into overlap with EU batch jobs. Thinking of doing 3 cohorts of 8 nodes each with 20m gap.
lee_sre: If we do 3 cohorts, ensure pod disruption budgets are respected. Add quick smoke check after each cohort: `curl -sS https://health.internal/eu-west3 | jq .ready` and check latency p95 on the API gateway.
natalie_prod: @jordan_infra +1 to shifting. Please add a canary cohort with lower-traffic racks first and notify product if we hit >2m request tail increase.
jordan_infra: Plan (short):
1) Preheat prefix cache on fallback pool for 15m.
2) Cordon nodes in cohort.
3) `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m`
4) Apply NIC microcode + reboot
5) Run smoke checks (lee_sre steps)
6) Uncordon and wait 10m before next cohort.
Will annotate runbook with exact node lists.
lee_sre: Add a quick capacity backfill command if eviction rate spikes: `scale jobs eu-west3-backfill --replicas 3` (ops queue)
sam_ops: Oncall ok with shifted window? @oncall-bot please confirm rotation coverage for 01:00-04:00 UTC.
oncall-bot: Oncall rotation: lee_sre will be primary 01:00-05:00 UTC. Pager policy unchanged.
jordan_infra: Cost note — expected extra spot backfill hours ~12 GPU-hours, estimate ~$45. If more than 30 GPU-hours needed we should pause and re-evaluate.
natalie_prod: I'll post a short customer-facing note if we see >5% tail errors. Otherwise keep internal comms. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: update scheduled-maint channel 30m before window with start time and cohort info.
lee_sre: LGTM. I'll join for the canary cohort and watch p95.
jordan_infra: Thanks — finalizing runbook now and will push updated schedule at 1765234900 (10m before start).
